title: Raphinha talks Pedri, Lamine, Lewandowski, Flick, Messi, Alvarez, Ballon d’Or, Saudi offer
tweet: Raphinha says the Ballon d’Or belongs to Lamine, citing his titles and style, and notes that the switch to number 9 under Flick has sharpened his confidence. He says Flick’s arrival convinced him to stay at Barça, even after a tempting Saudi offer, because the club still wants him. As things stand, his 11 goals in seven games show the value of the new role, but the club’s willingness to keep him remains the deciding factor.

title: Barcelona closing in on American artist as leading option for this year’s El Clasico shirt
tweet:
Tyler, The Creator is the frontrunner for Barça’s next El Clásico shirt, with talks with Spotify reported as advanced but not finalised.  
This would extend the club’s artist‑shirt tradition into the fashion‑music crossover space, potentially widening its global audience.  
Whether the deal is sealed remains to be seen.
